known.article: Champlain Valley of New York AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "Champlain Valley of New York AVA"

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A New York AVA in the northeastern corner, beside the Canadian and Vermont borders. Its short growing season suits cold-hardy hybrids such as Frontenac, La Crescent and Marquette, not the vinifera grapes grown in surrounding areas.
